title: Excellent tool for habit change
body: After reading Marshall Goldsmith’s Trigger (the best book I have read on behaviour change). I have been looking for an easier way to implement the key concept in the book - identify the habits you want to change and rate yourself every day - HabitBull offers exactly that. Not sure if the app is inspired by the same concept, it is extremely helpful. Highly recommended. Only reason for four starts instead of 5 is because the analysis could be more detailed and customizable.

title: Very effective habit tracker
body:
Wish it had a way of accepting "no" as successful today. For e.g if I am tracking smoking habits, I want "no" to mean successful.

Besides that, I absolutely love the structure of this habit builder. I have tried others but this is the one I stuck with. It can track numbers and yes or no habits.

Besides habits it can even track how much of something you have consumed. For e.g I use it to track milk consumed, holidays the maids take, etc 😆. Easy way to calculate how much money I owe to various people at the end of the month.

.
